caption: The drawing depicts a brown, wooden, hand-crank coffee grinder with ornate, carved patterns on its square body and drawer. The main body is a cube with a decorative floral or star-like design carved into each visible side, and it sits on a slightly larger, tiered base. On the top surface, there is a metal grinding mechanism, shown as a round plate in the center, with a metal crank arm attached. The crank arm is bent and topped with a rounded wooden handle. The front of the grinder features a small drawer, also decorated with a carved pattern, with a round metal knob handle for pulling. The entire object is rendered in realistic colors, with shades of brown for the wood and gray for the metal parts, and the background is a plain off-white or beige. The image is framed with a thin border and includes the handwritten note “1/2 Actual Size” below the grinder as well as a signature in the lower right corner.
title: Coffee Grinder
